annotation.evidence_span: Consequently, if a keep-alive mechanism is implemented it MUST NOT interpret failure to respond to any specific probe as a dead connection.
annotation.interpretation_a: The connection must never be considered dead based on any probe failure, even if multiple failures occur.
annotation.interpretation_b: The connection may be considered dead after multiple probe failures, but not after a single failure.
annotation.justification: The clause permits two materially different implementation behaviours regarding when a connection can be deemed dead, due to an incomplete constraint on the number of failures.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify how many probe failures are required to consider a connection dead, leaving the threshold ambiguous.
